_readme: TEMPLATE. Change the three YOURNAME strings below before pasting this into Slack.
https://api.slack.com/apps -> Create New App -> From an app manifest.
Every scope is justified in SCOPES.md. Trim before installing if you want a smaller
surface -- that is a reasonable thing to want, and SCOPES.md says what each one costs.
Slack ignores unknown top-level keys, so this comment block is safe to paste as-is.
NOTE: channels:manage is deliberately ABSENT. Adding it lets the bot create, rename and
archive channels, and voids the 'requests nothing administrative' property.
